messages:
Lena Park: Quick sync — enterprise asked for per-route cost breakdown + error-slice dashboard. Need to decide what lands in M2 (next sprint) vs M3. Can we do a short tradeoff?

Sam Patel: TL;DR: customers want top-10 costly routes + direct trace links. Dashboard + a tracing hook for slow/5xx is the ask. ETA: dashboard ~5 dev-days, tracing hook ~3 dev-days (infra excluded).

Diego Alvarez: Backend notes: we need hotpath sampling + per-request cost tags. Infra effort ~4d for sampling + 2d for cost attribution schema changes. Also a migration for request metadata.

Maya Chen: UX: dashboard MVP = 1) cost over time by route, 2) 95p latency by route, 3) error rate by route, 4) trace link per-row. Keep layout minimal, no complex filters for MVP.

Arjun Singh: Ops question: do we commit to automatic rollback if error regression >1% after rollout? That seems heavy. I suggest alerts + manual rollback for now.

Lena Park: Proposed launch criteria from customer: cost attribution accuracy >=90% for top-20 routes; trace link reliability >=95% for sampled requests; dashboard query latency <2s. Are these reasonable?

Sam Patel: 90% accuracy is ambitious with our first-pass hashing approach — we should expect ~80–85%. Recommend shipping with an "estimated" badge and progressive improvements.

Diego Alvarez: Implementation plan: M2 (canary): read-only dashboard with estimated cost and trace links for sampled requests. M3: improve attribution to target 90%+, enable tracing hook sampling for flagged routes, add error-analytics drilldown (stack traces, suspect spans).

Maya Chen: UX acceptance: each row shows route, cost %, 95p latency, 5xx rate, and a Trace link that opens the trace view. Filters: time range + route search only. That satisfies the customer demo ask.

Lena Park: Tradeoffs to hit M2: cut per-tenant breakdown (org-level only) and no per-user attribution. Everyone okay with that reduction?

Arjun Singh: Agree to the cut. Risk note: if canary undercounts cost, we need a visible fallback. Propose a flag `obs_cost_estimated=true` exposed in dashboard and API.

Diego Alvarez: I'll add a runbook entry: if error regression correlates with rollout tag, revert canary and notify product/eng oncall. Also add a metric to detect attribution divergence >10%.

ops-bot: Observability Rollout Handoff scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am PST — join link posted in calendar. :calendar:

Sam Patel: Next actions: I'll create/update roadmap tickets: PRO-472 Dashboard MVP, PRO-473 Tracing-hook Canary. Assign Diego (backend), Maya (UX), Arjun (ops). Lena — can you confirm acceptance criteria in PRO-472?

Lena Park: Will confirm acceptance criteria in the ticket today. Final ask from customer: demo in 3 weeks. Canaries + minimal dashboard demo should be possible if we stick to cuts.

Diego Alvarez: Noted — I'll bump infra priority. If anything blocks, I'll call it out in the ticket.

Sam Patel: Great. If no objections, we lock M2 scope and start work tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Lena Park: locking scope for M2: dashboard (org-level cost + latency + 5xx + trace links), tracing hook (canary sampling), visibility flag for estimated costs. Will post final checklist later.
